note: team, treasury and deployer keys are deliberately omitted here: they are held as GitHub secrets. They are not confidential -- anyone can read them from the chain with team()/treasury()/owner() -- but they are left out so this public file does not restate them.
recordNote: Transcribed from the deploy run's log, not copied from the runner's own file: the runner writes deployments/avalanche.json into its workspace and uploads it as an artifact, and that artifact is not committed. deployedAt is the second the run printed the address, so it may trail the actual block by under a second. It is what DEPLOYED_AT in server/src/lib/gameLogic.js mirrors, and therefore what day 0 is.

supersedes.why: Freely transferable, and carried the on-chain name 'Aeterna Bloodline' — both fixed at construction, so neither could be changed without a redeploy.
